description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for email subscription search filter parameters within the OrangeHRM admin module. It extends a base filter parameters class and specifies allowed sort fields, initializing the sort field in the constructor.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filter parameters related to email subscriptions, allowing only certain sort fields and setting a default sort.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters by setting the default sort field to 'emailSubscription.name'.
